verdict.rationale: LangSmith supports native LangChain tracing and explicit OpenAI SDK wrapping (wrap_openai), plus OpenTelemetry-based tracing and multi-language SDKs, which covers many integration paths including Vercel AI SDK via OTel. However, community feedback notes limited support for non-LangChain frameworks (e.g., CrewAI) and that it's fairly turnkey only for LangChain-based apps, requiring manual OTel instrumentation for other stacks.
